summary_en: 700,000 shares (5.05% of S/O ex-treasury) up to ¥2.1B via open-market purchases on TSE. Execution window 10 Aug 2026 – 9 Aug 2027. Rationale: balance growth investment capital retention with shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 7 August 2026, Aoba-BBT's Board of Directors approved the acquisition of treasury shares under Article 156 of the Companies Act (as applied via Article 165(3)). The program targets up to 700,000 ordinary shares, representing 5.05% of shares outstanding (computed as 700,000 ÷ 13,863,324 ex-treasury shares). The acquisition budget ceiling is ¥2.1 billion. Purchases will be conducted via open-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the window 10 August 2026 through 9 August 2027. The company stated that the acquisition balances medium- to long-term growth investment and internal capital retention against enhanced profit distribution to shareholders, while taking into account stock price levels and the company's financial foundation and future investment plans. No maximum price per share is disclosed.
